blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY – Vice Gov. Robert Fernandez and 11 members of the Sanggunian Panlalawigan have resumed their duties after serving their six-month preventive suspension over alleged irregularities in the use of the province’s P30.5-million disaster response fund. In a memorandum dated Nov. 25, Fernandez said their reinstatement took effect on Nov. 25 by operation of law, citing Section 24 of Republic Act No. 6770, or the Ombudsman Act of 1989, which limits preventive suspension to six months. The suspension was ordered by Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on May 22 in connection with a complaint filed by Gov. Patrick Alain Azanza over […]...
